WITH sales AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date AS d, f.net_amount AS amt
  FROM (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id)=1) f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'),
rets AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, r.return_date AS d, -r.refund_net AS amt
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'),
mine AS (SELECT store_id, sum(amt) net FROM (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rets) GROUP BY 1),
mine_raw AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) gross_raw FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales) ctl_net, sum(net_sales_before_returns) ctl_before FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT c.store_id, round(m.net,2) mine, round(c.ctl_net,2) ctl, round(m.net-c.ctl_net,2) diff, round(r.gross_raw,2) raw_before_ret, round(c.ctl_before,2) ctl_before
FROM ctl c FULL JOIN mine m USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN mine_raw r USING (store_id) ORDER BY abs(coalesce(m.net,0)-coalesce(c.ctl_net,0)) DESC, store_id LIMIT 15

WITH raw AS (SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) raw_amt FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1),
ded AS (SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) ded_amt FROM (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id)=1) f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) c FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT store_id, raw_amt, ded_amt, c, (SELECT count(*) FROM ctl) nctl FROM raw JOIN ded USING(store_id) JOIN ctl USING(store_id) WHERE abs(raw_amt-ded_amt)>0.001 OR abs(ded_amt-c)>0.005 OR abs(raw_amt-c)>0.005

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date AS d, f.net_amount AS amt
  FROM (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id)=1) f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'),
rets AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, r.return_date AS d, -r.refund_net AS amt
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'),
net AS (SELECT store_id, sum(amt) net_sales FROM (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rets) GROUP BY 1),
tdays AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, count(*) trading_days
  FROM dim_store st
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT calendar_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=5 AND is_trading_day) d
  WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id<900
    AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date<=d.calendar_date)
    AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date>=d.calendar_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=st.store_id AND d.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
  GROUP BY 1),
offday AS (SELECT s.store_id, count(DISTINCT d) sales_days FROM sales s GROUP BY 1)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY n.net_sales/t.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, round(n.net_sales,2) AS net_sales, t.trading_days,
  round(n.net_sales/t.trading_days,2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day, o.sales_days
FROM net n JOIN tdays t USING(store_id) JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=n.store_id AND cs.is_current LEFT JOIN offday o USING(store_id)
ORDER BY 1
